STL-FL: frozen 14.3% / fresh 52.7% / shelf-stable 30.2%

questions.answer: Analyst delivered a 30-item stratified sample for chef spot-check (not a self-validation). Method: 10 SKUs per account (TBR/TBJ/STL), top-4-by-spend + 3 mid-spend + 3 tail, stratified across food categories (protein, poultry, meat, seafood, dairy, produce, frozen). Each row carries the classifier's storage_axis verdict + confidence + reason for chef review. Confidence scores span 65-95; the sample includes both high-confidence unambiguous cases (fresh produce, IQF frozen items) and lower-confidence edge cases (bacon, sausages, cheese with no explicit fresh/frozen marker) so a chef can validate the boundary calls. This delivers the sample; final storage-axis certification still requires chef sign-off. Provenance: scripts_phase5/_q21_fresh_frozen_sample.json (30 rows).
